0xf09a4016.notice: Runs the access-control + Axelar-adapter module initializers. MUST be invoked via the diamond's `initialize` `_init` delegatecall.

params.admin: The address granted `DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE` (controls every adapter setter).
params.gateway: The Axelar gateway the adapter dispatches `callContract` to and validates inbound calls with.

natspec.notice: One-shot initializer for an Axelar gateway-adapter diamond — seeds AccessControl so the chain-equivalence and remote-gateway setters are admin-gated, and wires the Axelar gateway (registering the ERC-7786 interface via ERC-165). Delegatecalled by {Diamond.initialize} inside the initializing window (so it must NOT open its own pre/postInitializer; each `__*_init` guard passes because the window is already open). Companion to the {ERC2981Init} and {ChainlinkAdapterInit} patterns — a first-class production deploy artifact.
